lines.text: Best pizza in town. Believe me?
This pizza is the best in town, no cap.

data.define: Used to say that you are being completely honest.

example.text: This pizza is the best in town, no cap.

misuse.text: Don't say 'no cap' about a baseball hat.

data.l1_hook: शहर की सबसे बेहतरीन पिज़्ज़ा है, "no cap"। विश्वास करो?
data.l1_ex: यह पिज़्ज़ा शहर की सबसे बेहतरीन है, "no cap"।
